surfaced_definition: A decision counts as surfaced if, before the first draft of the material it affects, the agent either (a) asks the user about it, or (b) states the choice it is making and why, in a way the user could object to. Mentioning it only inside the draft, or only after the user approves, does not count.

decisions.decision: Which interest leads the SoI and the email
options_in_play: Product analytics / experimentation (most prominent in memory)
People's understanding and sense of control when AI features make choices with their data (primary; faint in memory)

decisions.decision: Which experiences to foreground and which to drop

decisions.decision: How to describe Prof. Li's research and which work to connect to
options_in_play: Recent user-facing work on how people understand and control what AI systems do with their data

options_in_play: Partial overlap, stated honestly, with what Riley would need to learn
decisions.persona_preference: Honest partial fit: overlap on people's understanding of data-driven systems; privacy is not Riley's main frame; no research background beyond class projects
